ITEM 1 | Green beans, bright green with slightly darker tips, glossy and lightly cooked, whole pods about 8-10 cm long and roughly 0.8 cm thick, arranged in a loose cluster on the left side of the plate, covering about 15% of the plate surface, piled 1-2 cm high | 85
ITEM 2 | Two rounds of yellow corn, pale golden-yellow with a cut face showing pale cream kernel rows, each round about 4 cm diameter and 2.5 cm thick, lying flat near the lower left of the meat, matte and moist-looking | 70
ITEM 3 | Mixed salad greens, dark and light green leaves with some torn pieces, thin shreds of orange carrot, pale slivers of onion or radish, lightly dressed and glossy in places, mounded on the upper right of the plate covering about 20% of the plate and 3-4 cm high | 60
ITEM 4 | Sliced grilled meat, brown with dark charred edges and reddish-brown glaze, cut into slabs about 6-7 cm long and 1-1.5 cm thick, fibrous grain visible, slightly juicy with a sheen, arranged in overlapping pieces across the lower right of the plate covering about 18% of the plate | 130
ITEM 5 | Dark reddish-brown sauce or glaze, glossy and slightly sticky, pooled and smeared over the meat and beneath the salad, with bits of red chili and flecks of herb, covering a thin layer about 0.3 cm thick | 20
